set.approach: From the dirt turnout on Chimney Peak Road, follow the ridge northeast of the turnout up to the foot of Sugar Pine Dome, the prominent dome with a big pine at its base. That spot is the usual base camp, but there is no water, so carry it in. The other domes lie a further short walk from there. This route is on Mega Dome, uphill and southeast of base camp, and takes the crack and ramp system left of the huge roof on the dome's north face.
set.descent_text: After the last pitch, belay on the slabs above, walk the ridge east and rappel from slings on the north side of the dome.

set.approach: From Keller Peak Road, take the good trail that starts at the edge of Campsite 2 up to Lower Dinosaur Rock. Skirt the base of the north face from the east to reach the entrance of the hidden corridor between the two opposing walls; some scrambling is needed to get to the climbs. The north-side routes are along the right wall as you enter. The route begins up the neighbouring Three Best Holds line, then angles right across the right-hand wall of the corridor.

review.notes: Corridor approach from the area pages; start position from the route Location line. No descent source for corridor routes.
